title: T1593.001 — Search Open Websites/Domains - Social Media
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Search Open Websites/Domains - Social Media with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram of T1593.001: an attacker creates a fake recruiter profile on a social network, searches for staff of a fictional company, maps the org chart, harvests contact details, sends connection requests and a job-offer message, while the company security team sees nothing until staff report the contact. A written version of all eight steps follows below the diagram.

steps.title: Build a fake recruiter profile
steps.caption: The attacker registers a polished recruiter identity: a photo that is not theirs, a plausible history, copied posts.
steps.defender: The profile lives on the platform. Nobody at the company can see it yet.

steps.title: Search for the target's staff
steps.caption: A company filter lists employees. The attacker sorts: engineers, then IT, then anyone posting about problems.
steps.defender: Profile views are invisible to staff and to the SOC.

steps.caption: The research phase produced zero company logs. Every signal so far is human: profile feels odd, message feels too curious.
steps.defender: This is why fast, easy reporting matters. A one-click report turns staff into sensors.
